### Observed differences

- A04 becomes much more common: participation rises from about 15% to 72% of traces, and mean occurrences per trace from 0.16 to 0.79. [OCC001]
- A06, A08, and A10 become less common: participation drops from about 22%, 18%, and 20% to about 7%, 6%, and 6% respectively. [OCC002, OCC003, OCC004]
- Routing changes: A14 now goes to A04 in about 70% of its transitions (was about 1.5%), and A04 now goes to A15 in about 89% (was about 10%). [DIR005, DIR002]
- A19, A20, A25, and A26 now go to A27 in about 92–97% of their transitions (previously they went to A29/A33). [DIR007, DIR008, DIR009, DIR010]
- A28 now goes to A29 in about 98% (was about 49%), and A29 now goes to A33 in about 99% (was about 47%). [DIR011, DIR012]
- A46 now goes to A25/A26/A19/A20 instead of A27 (A27 share drops from about 83% to about 1%). [DIR013]
- Position shifts: A04 moves earlier (mean position from 0.53 to 0.17), A19/A20/A25/A26 move earlier (from ~0.60 to ~0.35), while A27/A28/A29 move later (from ~0.32/0.55/0.59 to ~0.37/0.59/0.63). [POS001, POS003, POS004, POS005, POS006, POS007, POS008, POS009]
- Relations: A14 now precedes A04 in about 65% of traces (was 12%), A04 precedes A15 in about 40% (was 1.5%), and A04 precedes A27/A28/A29/A33/A46 in about 64% (was ~6–8%). [REL001, REL002, REL007, REL008, REL009, REL010, REL011]
- A19/A20/A25/A26 now precede A27/A28 in about 20–30% of traces (was 0%). [REL012, REL013, REL014, REL015, REL016, REL017, REL018, REL019]
- LAG: A14 and A04 become adjacent (lag 1) in about 98% (was 60%), A04 and A15 lag 1 in about 50% (was 23%), A28 and A29 lag 1 in about 99% (was 49%), A29 and A33 lag 1 in about 99% (was 48%). [LAG005, LAG001, LAG014, LAG018]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that the process was restructured so that A04 is now an early step, and the order of several activities changed: A14 now leads to A04, A04 leads to A15, and A19/A20/A25/A26 now lead to A27 instead of A29/A33, while A28 leads to A29 and A29 leads to A33. Also A46 now leads to A25/A26/A19/A20 instead of A27. This is supported by consistent changes in occurrence, routing, position, and relations. Limitations: the evidence comes from two finite samples, and some LAG items have low support, but the main DIR and REL items have strong support. A competing explanation is that the observed differences are due to sampling variation, but the number and consistency of changes across many indicators make that unlikely.
